condition.condition: fifth and seventh from Lagna or Moon occupied/aspected by ninth lord, benefics, or their own lords

normalized_rule: The source says the fifth and seventh places from the Lagna or Moon bear fruit when they are occupied or aspected by the ninth-house lord, benefics, or their own lords.
synthesis_notes: This is a Mantreswara/Phaladeepika proposition, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The condition is retained as a source marriage indicator; it is not a universal compatibility score. COMPATIBILITY is not used because this candidate is not a compatibility score or method.
